resources.string: Shows real-time bus arrival information for your selected stops
Small widget - Shows real-time bus arrival information (2x2) - Maximum 1 bus stop with two arrival entries
Medium widget - Shows real-time bus arrival information (4x2) - Maximum 2 bus stops with two arrival entries each
Large widget - Shows real-time bus arrival information (4x4) - Maximum 3 bus stops with two arrival entries each
